title: Yes, then counter: of two parties, one says yes to Tuesday, then two hours later says Wednesday is better; then the other says yes to Wednesday. Move the first yes, book Wednesday, never Tuesday.
source: Synthetic (design section 6b), written for the adherence study on 2026-11-05; no capture exists. Calendar generated by scenarios/synthetic/calendar.ts from Bob's weekly pattern (titles, attendees and places in the captured fixtures' anonymized vocabulary), the scheduling policy is plan 39's (Winnie's config at ca6b6ee). An event's `capture` is the expected path's carry, not a recorded run: it is used only when a later event runs on its own.

thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find 45 minutes for the three of us
next week to kick off the project? Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hello,

I'm Winnie, Bob's virtual assistant. Bob asked me to set up 45 minutes with you both on a Meet link. Here are times that work on his side:

- Tue, Nov 17, 3:30pm to 4:15pm ET
- Wed, Nov 18, 12:00pm to 12:45pm ET
- Thu, Nov 19, 10:00am to 10:45am ET

If one of those suits, say so and I will send the invite. If none do, send me a couple of times that work for you and I will check them.

Winnie
Virtual scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Offered three times on a Meet link, Bob in cc.

events.trigger: Ira Wren replied on the thread.

thread.text: Tuesday at 3:30 pm works for me.

expect.basis: The accept rule: record_yes Ira on slot 591; Jules has the same proposal and no yes, so nothing to book and nobody to ask yet.
expect.notes: alsoAccept ask_bob: a status note to Bob after recording the yes is as good as waiting. alsoAccept ask_party and propose (fixed after the 2026-11-05 smoke run): the loop prompt says "If one is in and another is not, propose or ask the one who is not", so nudging Jules is the rule as written.

events.trigger: Ira Wren replied on the thread.

thread.text: Actually, Wednesday would be better for me if it's still open. Sorry for the switch!

expect.basis: record_yes replaces a party's earlier yes (tools.ts: one yes per party), so Ira's yes moves from 591 to 592 (Wednesday's only offer); Jules still has no yes.
expect.notes: alsoAccept as event 0 (ask_party and propose: the rule says ask the one who is not in). A record_no on 591 first is also a right first step for A.

events.trigger: Jules Marchetti replied on the thread.

expect.basis: Everyone in on 592 (Ira's moved yes, Jules's new one): record Jules's yes, book 592 with both, tell Bob it is behind a card. A booking on 591 (Ira's first yes) would be the double-booking the scenario tests.
